title: I made Zen & Now, a calm sand garden you can rake in your browser (or let it rake itself)
author: ABS-Game-Dev
selftext:
Game Title: Zen & Now

Playable Link: https://zenandnow.app/?p=11

Platform: Web browser (phone and desktop)

Description: Zen & Now is a small sand garden you can play with in your browser. Rake the sand into lines and curves, then set stones, plants and lanterns wherever you like. Trace mode turns it into a game: follow a pattern with the rake and see how cleanly you can draw it. When you'd rather just watch, switch to Watch and the garden rakes itself, so it works as a calm screensaver and sound machine in a tab while you work. There's no timer and no score anywhere else in it, which is the point: it's for the minute between meetings or the end of a long day. It plays in any browser on a phone or a computer, with no download or sign-up. I'd love to hear what feels calm, what doesn't, and what you'd add to the garden.
